messages:
Claire: FYI the release candidate is blocked in artifact-verify after an aggressive cache eviction ran during prefetch. seeing 404/412 reads from the index and deploybot keeps retrying.
Ben: on it. dashboard shows a burst of index misses for about ~15 artifacts, looks like eviction tombstones.
Sam: pasting the index debug tail:
```
2026-07-12T02:14:17Z cache-evict: start shard=27 ttl=7d
2026-07-12T02:14:18Z index: mark tombstone /shard-27/manifest/sha256:9f8a...
2026-07-12T02:14:18Z verify: read manifest sha256:9f8a... -> 412 manifest missing
2026-07-12T02:14:18Z deploybot: verify retry id=sha256:9f8a... attempt=4
2026-07-12T02:14:19Z deploybot: backlog=31 waiting on index shard lock
```
ops-bot: Promotion paused by deploybot. default retry/backoff enabled. Pending verifies: 31.
Claire: change window closes in 38m. Decision options: (A) quarantine this candidate and promote stable image (sha256:77aa), (B) try targeted shard un-evict (repair) now (est 20-35m), (C) temporarily reduce VERIFY_PREFETCH to false so verify skips prefetch and may pass.
Ben: quarantine+promote stable is fastest. the failing artifacts are limited to non-critical assets.
Sam: repair could fix the root cause but risks missing window. we should also add an automatic pre-deploy check that blocks eviction jobs during active promotions.
ci-bot: sanity: stable image sha256:77aa passed full CI today; smoke ok.
Claire: leaning quarantine+promote. we'll capture repair as follow-up. any objections in 90s?
Ben: +1. Also recommend adding MON-214 for index-evict overlap alerts.
Sam: I'll open ART-2001 (investigate tombstone races) and INFRA-502 (evict-quiesce during deploys).
Claire: executing manual promote: /promote --image sha256:77aa --by claire --note "quarantine candidate; eviction caused manifest verify failures"
deploybot: promote received. skipping prefetch and forcing verify on stable image sha256:77aa. Verify queued on runner-9.
deploybot: verify passed on runner-9 id=sha256:77aa. rollout starting.
deploybot: rollout complete. Change-window preserved. :tada:
Claire: release notes snippet: "Quarantined release candidate due to index eviction overlap that caused artifact verify failures; promoted stable image sha256:77aa to maintain window. Follow-ups: ART-2001 (tombstone race investigation), INFRA-502 (evict quiesce), MON-214 (evict/verify overlap alert)."
Ben: adding RELEASE-612 (post-release rebuild of candidate) and tagging infra tickets.
Sam: I'll attach index logs and schedule a runbook update for eviction jobs.
ops-bot: tickets created: ART-2001, INFRA-502, MON-214, RELEASE-612.
Claire: thanks everyone. closing thread.
